notes: Dual-MuMu support. Watchdog now discovers multiple MuMu installations simultaneously, including Global MuMuPlayer and Chinese MuMu (CN), traces each installation's own mumu-cli and ADB endpoint, and gives every VM a family-qualified identity such as global-0 or cn-0 so duplicate VM indexes cannot collide. PID, status, log files, and linked or independent settings now use the qualified identity. Legacy numeric instance settings migrate to global-* automatically. The UI labels both families explicitly and redirected PowerShell output is decoded as UTF-8 so CN device names render correctly instead of mojibake.
